correctness.rationale: All positive metrics in the two-level source family are covered. Exact trace/determinant algebra yields eigenvalues \(t(1\pm r)\); strict minimization in \(t\) and strict monotonicity in \(r\) prove uniqueness for \(1<p<\infty\), while explicit piecewise/equioscillation arguments cover \(p=1\) and \(p=\infty\). A standalone verifier numerically replays representative cases.
